title: Klipper reactor: prevent timer callback re-arming and reduce timer scan overhead
note: Backport of the Valve-Oil (thelegendtubaguy) timer improvements to QIDI's 02.04 Klipper. update_timer() ignores attempts to re-arm a timer while its own callback is running (or paused in another greenlet); the callback's running flag is cleared with try/finally. _check_timers() keeps the scan minimum in a local variable. Reviewed: the printer behaves the same (a re-arm during the callback was overwritten by the callback's return value anyway; the minimum comes out the same), it only does less work. Restarts Klipper.
